lead: Imran Tahir is a South African cricketer, born on 27 March 1979 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 47 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aries sign.
He has represented South Africa national cricket team and Lahore cricket teams.
This profile collects the Imran facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
